context.body: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderne….

observations.body: Nabal refuses David’s request, David arms his men, Abigail acts quickly with provisions and speech, David blesses her intervention, and Nabal dies.
